slides.psychology: Contrast Anchor — ثلاث أحجام متدرجة + Leading Lines من الظلال
slides.prompt: Professional product photography of these three aquarium heaters [1] arranged smallest to tallest left to right on a dark walnut wood shelf. Single warm pendant light from above creating long diagonal shadows as leading lines. Visible wood grain texture. Product fills 75% of frame. Rule of thirds composition. Arabic text at top: ثلاث قوات حسب حجم حوضك. 85mm lens, f/4.0, shallow depth of field, film grain. Portrait 4:5. No extra products, no cartoon, no illustration.

slides.psychology: Scale Anchoring — ولاعة BIC بجانب المنتج تبين الحجم الحقيقي
slides.prompt: This compact aquarium heater [1] placed diagonally on dark slate surface next to a standard BIC lighter for scale comparison. The heater is slightly longer than the lighter. Warm amber side light from left creating shadow. Visible slate texture with natural scratches. Product on right-third intersection. Arabic text at bottom: 50W — للأحواض لغاية 30 لتر. 100mm macro, f/2.8, film grain. Portrait 4:5. No extra products, no cartoon.

Dark brushed concrete wall straight-on with visible pores and one diagonal crack as natural leading line. Warm amber center glow. Corner vignette. Film grain. Arabic text centered: احفظ هالمنشور واطلب حسب حجم حوضك — aquavoiq.com. Portrait 4:5.

Condensation droplets on glass. Thermometer on upper-right third. Arabic text at center-left: حوضك شگد درجة حرارته هسة؟ Canon R5, 85mm macro, f/2.8, film grain. Vertical 9:16. 250px dark space top and bottom. No cartoon.

Dramatic warm amber rim light from left edge only, creating mysterious partial reveal. Positioned on left-third line. Arabic text at bottom-right: باچر بنوريك ليش الستيل أفضل من القزاز. Hasselblad X2D, 85mm, f/2.0, film grain. Vertical 9:16. 250px dark space top and bottom.

stories.prompt: Side-by-side comparison on dark slate: this old glass heater [1] on the left under cold flat fluorescent light looking fragile, next to this new steel heater [2] on the right under warm amber light looking strong. 3cm gap between them. Vertical 9:16. 250px dark space top and bottom.

stories.psychology: Scarcity — أسود على أسود = حصرية وغموض فاخر

Almost invisible in the darkness — only a razor-thin warm amber rim highlight along right edge reveals its silhouette. The near-invisibility IS the point. Product on right-third line. Arabic text at center-left: الساموراي الأسود — يختفي بالديكور. Hasselblad X2D, 85mm, f/2.0, vignette. Vertical 9:16. 250px dark space top and bottom.
